I never give bad reviews, but my experience with Dillon was far from ideal and left me in a very bad situation. However, I would like to be as fair and honest as possible. I am a student who was interning in a lab at the NY Department of Health. When I looked for apartments back in March for the summer, I had several options, but I picked Dillon’s because it was at a slightly cheaper price for being a private one bedroom with a kitchen in “the heart of Albany.” I wish now I would have paid a bit more for a more sturdy apartment or paid much less since the service I received could have been obtained at a much lower price. The main issue was that this is a very poorly built apartment.
Since day 1, the air conditioning did not work properly. It leaked about a quart of dirty water onto the floor every night. Dillon actually approached us first and said the other apartment in the complex had an issue and asked if the maintenance person could check out ours. I said yes. Nonetheless, the problem was never fixed. The next day Albany experienced a somewhat severe storm. This is where the bulk of our problems originated. The other guest staying with me informed me that the kitchen ceiling was pouring water. I messaged Dillon, he already knew about it and had sent 5 workers to our unit without informing me. I came home from work to several people placing giant fans (when I say giant I mean 3.5x2x2 foot) in this very small apartment. These fans were dehumidifiers that were extremely loud, limiting access to the kitchen and forcing us to stay in the bedroom with the broken AC. They also generated a significant amount of heat, heating the apartment to above 85 degrees.
When I messaged Dillon about this, he said this was all new to him, and he was working with the insurance to find a solution. I can understand that. I can imagine that this was stressful for him, the storm itself was not his fault. That said, what ultimately came from all of this was unacceptable and the reason for the low review.
Dillon offered me three solutions 1) allow me to stay in the apartment with a discount during the renovation process, 2) allow me to remain in the unit until the renovation begins, then put me in a hotel for a week (and only a week regardless of renovation duration) and discount the apartment while I did not have use of a kitchen, or 3) have me find a new Airbnb and he will refund me.
I checked the other Airbnbs and at the time of searching there was only one that cost $16,000/month. I promptly responded that I could not take option three because of that reason. I then talked with my parents because I am not confrontational and frankly have a hard time knowing when I am being taken advantage of.
After discussion and some math, what I was being provided was a non-private (the workers were there from 9am-6pm), kitchen-less, and loud apartment. The apartment also had no air conditioning even before the storm. As such, I countered with what I thought an appropriate discount would be. Out of full transparency, I said I would pay $20/day as long as I don’t have a private apartment with access to a kitchen because I could not eat out for every meal. Considering he could not rent out the apartment to other people, I figured he’d still be making money, and I wouldn’t be paying for things I am not receiving. On multiple occasions, Dillon suggested that the renovations had not yet begun in the apartment even though the ceiling was destroyed and repair people were in there. He could only remedy the situation once the renovation had begun, not the “demolition.” For me the product was the same, and it wasn’t fair that I was paying so much when I could have stayed in a non-private apartment with roommates for much cheaper.
After my response, Dillon said he would get back to me in the morning. I woke up to my reservation being canceled due to “natural disaster.” This was the only option that would not have worked for me. Granted he allowed me to stay until the 20th of June (5 days after cancellation). However, there have been no new airbnb accommodations; I am not staying in a new Airbnb right now. The problem is, this wasn’t a natural disaster, this is a poorly buiqltq apartment. It is my belief that Dillon took advantage of the policy because he was unhappy that I asked not to be taken advantage of before the renovation began. He was perfectly willing to allow me to stay through said “natural disaster renovations” until I countered.
Ultimately, Airbnb did refund my stay, but Dillon’s actions were not only unprofessional but rather careless and dishonest. I work all day and come back to study for grad school exams in the evenings. Dillon was aware of these circumstances. His lack of empathy and his refusal to provide with an honest service is why I’m writing this review. I strongly urge you DO NOT stay here if there is any chance of rain or care at all about having a functioning AC unit. The apartment is made to look good, not be sturdy.

I immediately told Dillon and asked him to change the code for us (which he did) and he said the guests had tried to enter the wrong door. But later the guests left a note saying that they were hoping to "hang out there" since the unit had been unoccupied earlier. Huh? Turns out they were staying next door. What's concerning is that we either had the same door code or that, if they had been hanging out there before we arrived, the door code wasn't changed. With no deadbolt or some sort of extra lock on the door, this mishap certainly didn't make us feel safe knowing that other guests were about to walk on in. The central heating was just okay for our first two days but with the baseboard heater in the living room not working, it took a while for it to warm up. If you're coming in the winter, highly recommend bringing extra blankets if you can and wearing lots of layers as the central heating did virtually nothing when the very cold days hit. The windows are drafty even with the curtains drawn. And the thermostat was set to 90 and it never made it past 64 and blew out semi-cold air. Told Dillon all of this and wish that he could've provided us some sort of solution like space heaters or something. Lastly, the place was tidy but I wouldn't say clean. There was dust coated on the coffee table, the desk, end tables, floors, and other random surfaces when we arrived. We had to wipe everything down ourselves. The couch also had a lingering smell of smoke and heavy cologne which didn't make sitting on the couch seem inviting. Overall, good location and would be a nice space with some improvements, just maybe bad timing for us.

Comfortable place for a weekend stay!

The cons: (Which are mostly out of the host's control)

Linda as a host is amazing - and this is why I am giving this rental 5 stars - I think it is important to keep good hosts in the limelight on Airbnb so we all keep being able to find great hosts on this platform. The host had the good fortune of someone checking out of the unit on the 3rd floor the day after I checked in and when I noted the pot smoke throughout the entire unit and she was able to move me up there after her cleaner cleaned the unit for me. I REALLY appreciated the offer to switch units since the pot smoke was much less bad on the 3rd floor and without this I would have had to cancel my reservation and move to a different rental elsewhere or a hotel. All of her units are technically non-smoking and there are heavy fines for smoking in her units, so I was pretty confident in reserving that the units would be clean and not have any smell, and I can tell that Linda takes a great deal of pride in keeping her units neat, tidy, fully-stocked, modern, and very clean. But there is a tenant in the basement who I can only assume is a smoker and the smoke and the smell permeate the apartment building. That said, it really mostly affects the ground floor unit the strongest and the 3rd floor unit the least. Apart from that there were only minor things which other reviewers have mentioned-- the shower is only hot for a short shower, so don't wash your hair if you have long hair, and the stairs to the top floor are very narrow and steep, so don't bring too many items, or try to remain compact for minimal stress. Other than that, it was a great stay. The apartment is in good condition, well-located to downtown and lots of great food options nearby. Everything is clean and new and items are replaced if needed. Her communication is among the absolute best on the platform and she really looks after her guests. I also think it's super rare and wonderful that she allows dog guests with a reasonable fee and that is wonderful if you are traveling with your pet and would like to stay somewhere with a kitchen (there are a few hotel chains that allow pets, but obviously you won't have a kitchen). The apartment itself gets wonderful light morning and afternoon and has a nice little backyard area. Lots of parking. Some have noted that it is close to some train tracks, and it is, but I didn't find the noise from the trains that distracting or that loud. They are right there (a cool old bridge that the trains go over) and it's the main vista from the windows, but I found it to be pretty tolerable. Recommend a stay here, just be mindful of the situation with the smoke from the ventilation system. It might perhaps be better in the summer when you can leave windows open or when people aren't spending as much time indoors.

There are though, two things worth mentioning. One is possible to adjust, but the other is not. Firstly, as far as in-place features that's worth mentioning on is there is no smart TV or smart features. I'd easily and handily recommend this location if it's just a place for you to sleep in, but if you were hoping to also use it to wind down from an evening out, it may be best to bring a laptop, book, or board game to help with that. This is a clean and pleasant basement apartment in central Albany.   Plusses:  the living is large, and the bed is large and comfortable, as is the bathroom. There are glasses and tableware, but not a lot.  The table  is the tiniest table for two I have evmer seen at an Airbnb, and the kitchen has virtually no counterspace. (Drying dishes have to go in front of the microwave, blocking access.)  When we had a takeout dinner (from an Indian restaurant on the same street a couple of blocks away) we had to use the stove burners (not hot!) as a serving area as there literally was not room on the table for two plates, two glasses, and more than a very small plate of food.  This was inconvenient, but not terrible.   The neighborhood has a  lot of activity -- many restaurants (Indian, Chinese, Mexican, vegan, etc within a few blocks), bars, a Ben an Jerry's all within a couple of blocks. It is just over one block to the large and well kept Washington Park...great for walks or just sitting; there was a market there on Sat AM.  Apparently parking can be an issue -- we had no trouble pulling in on a Fri. evening in July getting a spot on the block of the apartment.  However, from what I saw on signs, there is a two hour parking limit during working hours on weekdays (M-F) so if you are there during those days (not evenings) you may need to move to a paid lot.

If you are used to city life, this isn't an issue (and the bedroom is located at the back of the building, so with the fan on we couldn't hear any street noise). The apartment itself is spacious and comfortable, and my daughter and I really enjoyed kicking our feet up on the reclining sofa for some late-night Netflix-ing at the end of some busy, adventure-filled days spent all over upstate NY. Getting in and out was a breeze with the Yale lock system. Street parking can be a challenge if you're unfamiliar with the area, so definitely pay attention to street signs. If you have a friend or colleague who is a member of the Center Square neighborhood association, have them register your license plate as a visitor (but there are still strictly-enforced parking rules for street sweeping and garbage collection). Brian’s place was a perfect location for us. It was close to a family member who lives in the area. The apartment is spacious and comfortable.  The neighborhood is walkable near many restaurants and Washington Square Park. We would stay there again.

Really a great place in one of the best streets in Albany. Brian is friendly and communicative.
Thanks for the great stay
Brian's place was comfy, close to what we needed and he was always friendly and responsive.

Brian's place was spacious, well put together and beautiful with a great location. It is right on Lark St. which makes it accessible to all the cool cafes, bars and restaurants. The apartment has an old rustic charm with high ceilings, huge windows, and a spacious living room. Enjoyed the stay very much, Brian was responsive, thorough with the information and very prompt with whatever I needed.
Beautiful apartment in a great location.
As advertised. Great breakfast spot recommended by host. Clean.

What a comfortable, cozy place to rest our weary heads! From a spacious comfortable bed to a cozy couch to enjoy some TV- Brian has ensured this space has everything you need! The area is extremely walkable to coffee shops and bars, perfect to cook a meal in (equipped with everything you need) and the perfect, communicative host for recommendations. Would definitely book again if in the area!

Brian was an exceptional host from time of booking and throughout our entire stay! 100% recommend booking this airbnb if you're staying in the Albany area. Lark St is a fantastic location and easy walking to capital and surrounding shops. 5 stars all the way!!!

Brian’s place was great. He’s a great host. Very responsive. The only thing I didn’t like about the locaton was the parking situation. It’s street parking and can be hard to get a spot especially if you get in late. Other than that his place is awesome and he can provide a temporary resident permit for parking. Would highly recommend.
Lovely apartment in a great location. Brian was a communicative and welcoming host.

My partner and I stayed here to attend an event at the Palace Theater, only a few miles away. Parking is parallel or in a lot close by. We elected to parallel park on nearby resident streets, which required a temporary resident permit. Brian let us know about this in advance and handled the permit on short notice. The bed was comfortable and the living room quite spacious. There were multiple restaurants within walking distance, which I appreciated after driving so long.
Overall, the Airbnb was clean, comfortable, and well-located for our plans. Were I to become comfortable driving in Troy, I would stay here again.

This stay was great! I've stayed at this airbnb twice and it's always very clean and peaceful. The house is just as described in pictures, and the area is great with alot of small stores and restaurants. There's also a very large and beautiful park nearby. Definitely would recommend for anyone staying in the Albany area!
Nice space, good location, lots to do in the area and close enough to downtown Albany for quick access via drive/uber
Brian has a great home, it was a great stay, highly recommend.

Stayed at Brian's place in Albany this past weekend with my partner and it was a great experience.  Everything was clean and neat. He had plenty of space heaters if we got chilly. It is right near a ton of restaurants and neighborhood bars.  Also walking distance to museums.  All and all we had a great weekend and would definitely  stay in one of his places again! Thank you for everything.

The apartment was clean and the bed was very comfortable. We appreciated the location very much. We had some issues with the heat that were not resolved during our one night stay but have been told they will be addressed before future guests arrive. As long as the heat is better, this is a great place if you want to hang on Lark Street. Parking was easy and no problem, too.

I stayed with a friend and my dog for only 2 nights. The home was clean and well organized which made us feel very comfortable. There’s plenty of restaurants that are walking distance and less than a 10 minutes drive from the home. The neighborhood was friendly and the street looks beautiful at night. Definitely recommend this place, especially if you have a dog with you.
Great place! The bed was SO comfy, it made it even more well worth it. Literally so many cafes and restaurants nearby as well as the park. Parking was easy. Would stay here again!

What a great apartment! The location is perfect around tons of shops and restaurants. Very comfy bed!
My only issue was when I checked in 30 mins after check in, there was cleaning staff inside. It just was quite alarming at first but all good. It was also a bit on the cool side but I’m used to that in my own home so it didn’t bother me… but just a warning if you like your place toasty.
Other than those two minor things it was a great stay and I would definitely stay here again.
This is one of the amazing finds. Brian communicates and responds timely. Definitely recommended.
Place was beautiful and great for at the very least a quick stay.

Beautiful space right along Lark Street, nearby great restaurants and bars. Space is beautiful, with high ceilings and a very comfortable king-sized bed. The unit doesn’t have central heating (space heaters instead), so bring extra warm clothes if staying during the winter

This listing could be a nice place to stay in Albany however as it stands currently it is not ready for visitors. The keypad did not work when we got there and there was no hot water for 2 out of the 3 days we stayed. The listing describes heating and cooling units available but this is inaccurate. The units are inoperable and so the only heat available are space heaters which were blowing the fuses of the rental (and not really doing a great job at keeping us warm). The mattress had some sort of stain on it (my fiancee believed it to be blood) and there was no water in the bathroom sink for the duration of our stay. This needs some work! Bars and restaurants nearby were great though!

The place was very clean and Brian was super communicative, which we really appreciated.
Unfortunately, there wasn’t any hot water, and the bathroom sink water didn’t work. By the time we realized it, it was too late at night to reach out for a fix. After a long day of travel and walking around the city, not being able to take a shower wasn’t ideal. The space heaters also didn’t work, so it was pretty cold inside. Thankfully, the bed was super cozy and we still got a good night’s sleep.
That said, the space itself was spotless, and welcoming, and felt like a whole home. while parking was a bit of a nightmare even with the parking permit- the location was great if you plan to walk or use public transportation. There are tons of restaurants nearby, which made exploring easy.
Good place, nice cozy feel.
Nice and clean. Great location.
Great location, clean large space.

Brian was very communicative and willing to help.  His place is perfect, just like the pics.  The bed is so comfortable.  It could not be in a better location, walkable to excellent restaurants, pubs/bars, coffee shops, the gay scene, The Egg performance center, funky shops.  I didn’t need my car once.
Really great spot in Albany near bars and restaurants! Great space, with a roomy living room, comfortable bedroom, and functional kitchen and bathroom. Super easy check in!
We loved our stay! It was a perfect location — near lots of restaurants and the park.

We really enjoyed our stay! Most especially we loved the location on Lark, central to so many of our favorite shops and eateries. We could walk to the park and close to public transportation.
Brian was an amazing host and very responsive and accommodating .
I had a nice stay and Brian was helpful! Only a few blocks from the capital and convention center - I enjoyed the 20 minute walk there.

We fully enjoyed this spot. We did not spend a ton of time at the apartment, but everything we needed was available. The inside is well-kept and cozy. The neighborhood is cute with walkable places for food and drink.
For a quick stay, this was ideal. I want to say thank you to the host for being quick acting when I asked for help. That made us feel very welcome.

Thank you for everything
Niyas Corp
Wonderful location, great bars and restaurants. Responsive and helpful host throughout the visit.

Great living room area, had some family over for lunch and the room is bright and airy and able to fit a few people comfortably - easily walkable and very close to Washington park,  where we took our dog multiple times per day. Great coffee nearby at Jacob Alejandro and the pizza at SOHO was pretty good. Would definitely stay again.

Brian’s place on Lark Street is amazing! The apartment itself is cute, clean, and has everything you need. One you leave, there’s a million things to do, eat, see, and a gorgeous park right around the corner.
Brian's place was great.  Clean, well equipped, great location.  Lark St. was fun.
Thank you to Brian for hosting us! He was always responsive and it was the perfect location in Albany.

If  you’re looking to get in shape, the stairs at this place will help you get started! This place is absolutely fabulous. It looks kudu like the pictures. The closet is amazing, very clean and spacious! Michael is a great host, willing to answer your questions and get things fixed if need be. Great location if you’re looking to explore Albany.

The apartment is amazing. So spacious, and new. It’s a space you’ll look forward to ending your day at. Michael was great and super accommodating. I had a private parking space that was gated, and the ability to charge my e-car overnight. That was super clutch. Id stay here 10 out of 10 times.

This apartment was amazing! I lived here for about 4 months and have not one complaint. Beautiful and spacious apartment perfect for long term stays. The apartment looks just as it does in Michael's pictures and includes all listed amenities including a gated parking area in the back. I would 100% stay here again in the future.

I occupied the apartment for 6 months and it was great.  Whenever I had a question, Michael responded within minutes and was extremely proactive. George who helps maintain the property was great too. Always friendly and willing to help.  Thank you for everything.

Exactly as described. Michael was very nice, responsive and respectful of my privacy. I felt at home at all times and enjoyed my stay. It is near downtown and that makes it a busy area, so you can hear what's going on outside. I loved having a place to park and having a place to wash my clothes. The coffee maker was a nice touch, too.

This is my second time renting a separate property from Michael and it was the best accommodation I could hope for. His properties match the listing very accurately and are very spacious, clean, modern, and fully equipped with everything a person could need. Michael is very responsive and proactively addresses anything that may possibly be a concern before you'd even catch it yourself; I was very lucky to have had him as a host and to have caught a spot in two of his apartment while there was availability.

Awesome stay with an awesome host! The apartment is so clean, modern, very well secured and had amazing WiFi speed. Michael is very responsive and proactive. I will definitely recommend this place for anyone looking a spot in downtown Albany.

Spent a month here on a staycation, was so worth it. Modern, charming, cozy apartment, had everything I needed as soon as I walked in, felt right at home. Albany can be a tough city to feel safe in, but I felt confident, comfortable, and secure my entire stay. Noisy at times, but that’s inevitable in a city environment and overall the noise wasn’t that bad, I was able to sleep every night. Location isn’t far from highways, easy to take a day trip wherever you want. Michael was extremely kind and helpful, very responsive in the beginning. Loved this place, would 100% stay again.

Micheal is a great host. The place is awesome and is really a gem for Albany. I was not fond of the area it is in being a young and solo female traveller, but would be fine for most people especially couples. However, Michael has done everything possible including the private parking to mitigate as much as possible. Always felt very safe within the building with his security measures as well.
The place itself is lovely. Private parking, washer dryer, ac, a nice kitchen, spacious bathroom. I enjoyed my stay at Micheal’s

Stayed here for 2 weeks leading up to the bar exam (I took it at Empire State and it was walking distance; very convenient)
Honestly the space was lovely and I was able to quietly study. One thing to note is that the ceiling is high but a lot of noise could come through from the upstairs neighbor (eg. Foot steps). It didn’t bother me much during the day but I told Michael about it and he tried to resolve it! Wearing earplugs could help somewhat. Other than that, truly a fantastic place to live!!
Michael was fantastic!! place was beautiful.  fully renovated. really enjoyed my time there. Michael is a great guy!
Michael was a wonderful host that always communicated well with me! Apartment was clean, and very spacious!

Thomas’ house is stunning. We had a big group of people during our stay and there were plenty of beds with clean sheets and extra blankets. The outdoor space was beautiful with the pool, hot tub, grill, and plenty of seating for all of our group. Thomas was very easy to communicate with and answered all of our questions within minutes.
Amazing.  Book immediately

From beginning to end Thomas made this stay an evening that myself and all my friends will not soon forget. I rented his home for a night to host a bachelor/birthday party for one of my good buddies, who simply wanted a good cut of meat and a well-made martini to celebrate the occasion. I was initially planning to make all the food and drinks myself, but upon hearing this, Thomas went absolutely above and beyond and offered to coordinate getting us a private chef and a bartender! The menu the chef put together for us, and the drinks masterfully mixed by the bartender, were amazing, and not having to worry about taking care of those things myself allowed me to just relax and enjoy making memories with my friends.
The house and the grounds themselves are stunning, from the beautifully and artfully decorated farmhouse to the oasis of the backyard patios and pool space appointed with tropical trees and plants, you would never know you were staying in a home in the center of Albany! We really did not want to leave the following day, which is why it was so nice that Thomas allowed us to stay a bit longer to enjoy the pool on such a hot morning. 😊
Thomas’ cohost, Delvin, is lovely. He allowed me to check in early so I could set some things up ahead of everyone else arriving. When I showed up, he was still in the middle of cleaning and preparing the house for us but took the time out to warmly welcome me and give me a tour of the house and accommodations. He also stayed throughout the dinner service to assist the chef in preparing the table and clearing everything down when it was over. It was wonderful having his company while we were there.
If I could give Thomas, Delvin, their property, and this experience more than 5 stars, I would. Highly recommend!!
Gorgeous house with everything you could want or need. Thomas was so accommodating and was quick with communication. Hope to book again in the future.
Awesome house and a great host. Thanks Thomas!

Amazing home! Thomas was there to meet us and even provide a quick tour.
Photos in the listing are outdated as tons of renovations have been done. He definitely over delivered!
We were able to host a Christmas eve dinner for 13 people, and the space provided was more than enough.
We'll definitely want to stay here again!
The house was just beautiful!  Very tastefully decorated and just lovely.  The beds were very comfortable, and everything was very luxurious.
Just perfect! From the pool to decor, we loved it so much.
Beautiful house, and the pool was the best!

Beautiful home and well appointed with all the comforts you could think of! Thomas and Justin are so responsive and made sure everything was good.  Thank you and hope to be back in the area again soon so we could stay again
Beautiful home and fantastic hosts

Amazing airbnb. We booked this for our family to stay at for a wedding weekend. Host was extremely responsive and accommodating. Will be recommending to any large groups that need a place to stay in Albany. We didn’t get time to enjoy the backyard but it had everything we could ever want.
Amazing outdoor spaces and funky decorations. Felt like home.
The kitchen was a great space for both cooking and hanging out as a family.

Thomas was extremely responsive. He assisted with last minute changes and made our stay extremely accommodating. The home was beautiful and large enough to make sure everyone from our group had a private space. We will be returning in the future.

We had a fantastic stay at the Jesse Bleu House! Thomas was a wonderful host, and the home exceeded our expectations in every way. The pool was a favorite for everyone—clean, inviting, and perfect for relaxing afternoons. We especially loved the covered rear patio, which made for a great spot to enjoy the outdoors while staying cool and shaded. The peaceful backyard offered a serene escape, allowing us to unwind as a family. There was plenty of space to either come together or spread out, which made it ideal for both bonding time and quiet moments. The third level was a major highlight—it felt like our own private suite, complete with a bedroom, bathroom, living area, and a convenient kitchenette with a microwave and fridge. It gave us that extra layer of comfort and privacy we didn’t even know we needed.
Being only about 10 minutes from the airport was incredibly convenient for our arrival and departure. The Jesse Bleu House is truly a Must Stay!
Thomas was a fine host and our stay was fine but we were unhappy with some of the decorations which we found at odds with our Christian values.

Beautifully renovated historic building, with great amenities - the heated pool was especially awesome! The house is very large and perfect for larger groups or multiple couples. Thomas was a great host, and dinner in his restaurant was amazing as well. I would highly suggest this house to anyone visiting Albany!
Best Airbnb experience in Albany
Linda is a great b n b owner very great communication.

Linda’s place was an amazing stay!! Her Airbnb was adorable and renovated very nicely. Linda was responsive and a great host! I loved staying here and would definitely return to any of her rentals. If you are bringing a car, be prepared for street parking.
Beautiful place, great location. Super quiet even though downtown is right around the corner. It was also nice and cool on a brutal 96 degree day! Easy to find and check in. Linda rocks!

5 stars across the board. very spacious and comfortable spot. Upscale which fits what I'm looking for when it comes to business travel. It made me feel right at home. Everything was 100% on point here. check in was easy, communication was great and the place was comfy. I would recommend this place to anyone. -L-

I am surprised by all the five star reviews. I actually wound up leaving early because I was not comfortable in the house. The high ceilings are great but there is no art, and no floor lamps or reading lamp in the bedroom so the only lighting are very stark bright white lights. Although it’s been remodeled recently, it’s not a very well done job and there are signs everywhere of work badly done, spots of paint on the floor, tape stuck to the toilet, and cable wires sticking out of the wall.
There’s no instruction book on how to work the TV and climate control units. No hand towels or any kitchen amenities except for an offbrand Keurig and some knives and plastic plates and glasses.
For women traveling alone and anyone in general two blocks down to the right when you come out is really not safe especially after dark. I had nightmares all night my first night.
Linda’s place was amazing! Very clean, roomy, and cute. Everything was in walking distance so we were able to leave our car behind and not worry about parking. Would definitely stay again!

I stayed for two nights and the place is exactly as pictured. Very clean and cutely decorated, but had trouble using the AC and wifi. Street parking is pretty limited so not amazing if you are driving. Not a safe walking distance to downtown in my opinion but Ubers were a 3 min drive so still very convenient. Linda was responsive and very friendly.
I had a great stay at Linda’s place. The home is exactly as shown in the pictures. We had an easy check in. Linda communicated effectively.
Linda has great communication. This bnb is very comfy I love it !! Really pretty inside !
Great Place. Very cozy, the amenities were on point. Price was definitely affordable Would definitely book again.

This location is exactly as described. Now initially when we arrived the heat was not on and there were some issues with getting the heat going, but the host was responsive and helpful and before you know it the heat was on and the place couldn’t have been more cozy. The neighborhood is nice and quiet. The home was clean and as advertised. Only issue I had was I wish there was some bottled water in the refrigerator as I arrived at like 1 am and I was thirsty. Otherwise great host. Any concerns I had were addressed in immediately even at 1 in the morning. The host even made sure I had a parking permit while I was there. Overall great host and nice clean place.
Nice open and bright apartment.

Good location and easily walkable to most things around downtown Albany. Accurate description to the place.
Took a while to get the first response as the Wi-Fi listed wasn’t the actually one to use. Eventually, so the some escalation, host responsiveness was a bit better after that.
Such a great place!  It was easy getting in, easy getting comfortable, excellent bed, and super clean.
Lindas place was great. I would book again.
The air bnb was clean and very cute!
Really enjoyed my brief stay at Linda’s! Really comfy foam mattress, soft sheets, comfy couch. Not lots of kitchen equipment but enough to get by.
Beautiful place in a great neighborhood. Very friendly and helpful host! Had a wonderful stay! Thanks Linda. 😊

Linda was super welcoming, responsive, and helpful during the time I stayed there. She took the time to help with parking as well. It was fairly easy to check in. The space was accurate to the photos, had the listed amenities, and is a good place if you come to Albany for a short trip!
The only things I’d say are that if you stay here, it would be best to check in during the day and not at night (we arrived closer to midnight due to travel time and the neighborhood wasn’t the safest as we were approached by some homeless people down the st; we later did more research and saw that the area a few blocks down to the right was a bit dangerous to be around). There were also a stain on the desk, and we found strands of hair left over on the bed when we had arrived. It was very hard to sleep at night because of the family living upstairs (they’re very loud)! The backdoor being next to the bed also made me worry. The shower could also use a curtain- other than that it was a good experience.
Great place!
Loved the place, extremely cozy in a great location close to everything! will be coming back soon
Linda and her cohost were extremely responsive and helpful. The apartment was clean and comfortable and check in was a breeze. They made the parking situation very easy to navigate
Extremely helpful and responsive. Absolutely recommend and will stay here again for sure!

We were in Albany  for a concert at the MVP arena it was a super easy quick walk from the apartment though the original route we took was a bit sketchy. The host was nice and very helpful. The  apartment was perfect and we felt comfortable and safe there.
Had an extended stay at Linda’s. Great host, very responsive, helpful and friendly. Highly recommend
It was the perfect place to stay for me. Very walkable to Albany attractions and venues. I would recommend this to anyone who loves to walk and take in their surroundings.

Linda’s place is exactly as described. It’s quiet, easy access, squeaky clean, street parking available. Super close/walking distance from all my favorite coffee shops downtown. Would love to stay again in the future. Thanks!
Great place for our short stay to visit extended family. AS typical with downtown locations parking can be a problem. That said I would stay here again.
place was great the only down side around the corner was a bad neighborhood but other then that great block and its street parking
Beautiful small spot right in the heart of Albany with your own reserved parking registration so you can park on the street and not worry about your car and go walk around the town all night !

Linda and JShing’s place was beautiful and exactly as pictured. It’s minimalist and we enjoyed that because it allowed us to set up shop and make the place ours while we stayed. The couch was deep and awesome. We all loved lounging there together and relaxing.
The BED IS SO COMFORTABLE! We slept like babies every night.The central air was great too since it is peak summer and the space is insulated well so it maintains the cool even if you need to turn the A/C off because it works really well and gets chilly in there if you leave it on.
Location is centrally located and walkable to many places you could want to see.
All in all, don’t hesitate to book!
Cozy, clean stay!  Cute apartment that was just what we needed for visiting for one night. Thanks again!

Linda is great. so helpful and very kind
I just love the apartment. we stayed twice.

I was so grateful to stay long term at Linda’s place while my home was under repair. She did provide me with a parking permit which was very helpful, although finding a spot at times was still difficult, especially in the evening hours. I would stay here again!
Great spot right downtown. Convenient access and parking. Would book again!
beautiful place near the albany capital center. Linda was very helpful.

Great location, walking distance from MVP arena. Space was very functional and convenient.

First and foremost, thank you so much for opening your space and allowing us to enjoy and experience it. Though a short stay, my family did create some great memories and would stay here again, given the opportunity.

1) I LOVE that Linda secured a parking permit for us but parking was challenging. We only stayed a few nights and most of the time we had to park quite a distance away.

There were a total of two towels, no extras, one hand towel and two wash cloths. That wouldn’t have been too bad if there was detergent to wash them, but we had to buy our own detergent to use the washer and dryer (which are amazing, might I add.)

I wasn't sure what character was but I learned here. The place is in a nice neghborhood with a nice park to go on a walk/run nearby. Houses in the area look really pretty. If that wasn't a thing, I would of liked the spot...
Linda’s place was amazing! The place is beautiful and super cozy definitely recommend to anyone in the area looking for a place to stay!
Linda home was outstanding and I would rent from her again at any of her other properties. Thank you for hosting.

Thanks very much for the great stay. The place is perfect. It is close to everything. So much better than staying in a hotel.  I thought parking may be an issue but that was easy. Everything was great
Wonderful stay and such a helpful host! Parking was sorted out before check in and the entire process was hassle free!
Great stay, as always! Quickly becoming my favorite stay in Albany!
Really nice location, shopping centre and caffees restaurant around the corner

The place was really and clean and peace. They just need to put cleaning supplies in the closet so we can have the ability to clean up. The shower kept leaking out water since their was no shower curtains so we had to clean up the water with paper towels on the floor. The drawers inside the bedroom kept opening up by itself and it was a little creepy. The closet doors in the bedroom was stuck.
Great place exactly as described. Linda was very responsive .

Fantastic stay at a historic brownstone in downtown Albany close to everything. The space is beautiful, comfy bed and sofa, perfect size for 1 or 2 guests. Host and her team were incredibly responsive, and the listing is exactly as described. Even though downtown, the neighborhood is extremely quiet. Would definitely stay here again!

I checked AirBnb a few weeks before my stay and nothing downtown was available, I booked far away by SUNY. Linda's place opened up 2 days before I arrived, I cancelled my hotel. The street is really nice with historic buildings and you are a walk away from everything. I came into town to see some shows at the arena, which is a 5 minute walk. The house was super comfortable and the street is very nice and peaceful. Thank you.

I can’t say enough about the place and my host! It was perfect during the snowed in days and the back yard was beautiful covered in white. The washer and dryer  came in handy and they had every dish I needed to cook. Most importantly I felt taken care of and that if I had any issue at all it would be handled professionally and with care. The parking permits were so useful and it was not hard to find spot. There is a park nearby that my dog and I visited. In a nutshell, we felt at home. I highly recommend and I will absolutely star here again!
Linda’s place was just what I needed for the few days I visited Albany. Would stay again.
Convenient for my stay, clean, quiet, and easy communication. Comfy bed and bedding!
Linda’s place is absolutely beautiful. It was close to the plaza, and parking wasn’t nearly as tricky as we had initially thought. Close to everything, spacious, would absolutely stay again!
Very relaxing and clean
Linda’s place was great. She was a fantastic host. We loved her place and extended our stay.  I would highly recommend her place.

The unit was extremely clean. Close to downtown, the capital and MVP arena as described. The check-in process itself was easy, however, I originally booked a different unit 1.5 miles away and there was no key in the lockbox. I called Linda. She was very friendly and quickly fixed the issue by swapping me to this unit. My only complaint is the original unit I booked had off-street parking and I wasn’t aware this property didn’t until after accepting the swap. Finding parking upon check-in was very easy so I didn’t bother to reach out. However, it was difficult to find a spot at night and I ended up parking a 10 minute walk away. I reached out to Linda upon check out regarding this inconvenience but haven’t heard back from her >1 week later. I would have appreciated acknowledgment and/or a small discount for the lack of off-street parking since the unit I originally paid for had it, but it’s not the end of the world. Overall, I would still recommend staying at one of Linda’s properties.
It was great. Friendly neighbors, clean and comfortable.
Linda's place was clean, spacious, perfect location and with a warm feel apartment!
Nice place. Clean and comfy. Everything looks the same like on the pictures.

Linda was very helpful and gracious as she helped me switch to a different properly.
This location was great. The apartment was clean and comfortable. I would definitely stay here again.

Linda's place has a nicely provided interior, however it is difficult to find nearby restaurants or markets that aren't in a "rough" or run-down part of town. However, it is within walking distance of the NY State Museum.

A solid and affordable option right in downtown Albany. The ceilings were tall, the sofa was wide, and we made good use of the kitchen. It was perfect for both relaxing and working while traveling. Overall, we had a wonderful stay.
We appreciated the smart TV setup, fast and reliable WiFi, and the hosts were generous enough to allow an early check-in. Each room had its own AC unit that cooled things down when needed and provided heat when it got chilly, giving us full control. The decorative fireplace was a beautiful touch, and the back French bistro area was a lovely bonus.
The neighborhood and building were slightly noisy at times, and there are no immediate stores or restaurants nearby, but everything is accessible a bit further out. We simply grabbed groceries and were all set.
We would certainly come back if we stayed in Albany.
Perfect for our extended stay- thank you, Linda!
Lori was a great communicative host. Everything was as advertised. I’ll book again!

Lori’s accommodations were perfect for our needs - very spacious and comfortable for a group of 3 traveling for work in the city. We wish we had more time to spend around the area, because this is a great place in a nice location that we would have liked to explore further. The place is lovely and clean, and exceeded our expectations. Thanks Lori for hosting us!

Excellent and beautiful house, very well maintained, clean, and have everything for a family or group of friends to enjoy. Nanette was also extremely responsive including when we had an unanticipated family emergency.

Nanette’s cottage is beautiful and clean. It had everything we needed (and more) for traveling with a baby and two toddlers. Nanette thought of everything that you could possibly need. We had a great stay, and highly recommend this home to anyone visiting Albany.  We are grateful to Nanette for making our stay memorable.

This place was absolutely stunning and well equipped with what you needed and so much more. I would highly recommend this place to anyone. It was clean modern nicely furnished and private perfect for any occasion.

Myself and three of my coworkers were attending a conference and this place was great for us because instead of having to get four hotel rooms, we booked this.  Each got our own room and nice spaces to hang out!!!

Wonderful cottage!  Clean and new with all the amenities and comforts of home. Close to freeway and essentials. Rented for local college grad weekend. Highly recommend especially for those that like nature and natural surroundings.

Nanette was extremely responsive and friendly during the booking and pre-arrival process, and the house itself is very charming. Highly recommend this place.

We had a wonderful stay at this beautiful cottage! Everything was perfect and our hosts were wonderful as well! The property is beautiful and the cottage is exquisite! We would love to come back and stay here again.
Nanette's home was great for our stay - very clean and just as described. Nanette was very accommodating and responsive.

This house is pretty much perfect! The house was very clean, the kitchen was well stocked, overall a very comfortable house.  We loved the decor and the outdoor space. We will definitely stay here the next time we come into town!

We would book it again!

Welcome basket of chocolates and designer cookies on kitchen counter. Would book without reservation. Host is very responsive and excellent with communication. Grocery store within five minutes.

Nanette’s place is lovely and I would 10/10 refer anyone to stay at this listing.

If you’re in Albany definitely consider this space!

gorgeous,  really nice place to enjoy Albany even if just a stopover. we loved the stay.

Nanette was a fantastic host! Very responsive and always available if we needed help. We had a fantastic stay and really enjoyed our time at this cozy home off the Yellow Brick Road! Highly Recommended!

Nanette is a great host and her property has been beautifully renovated and styled. We felt right at home from the moment we walked in. Location is easy to find, peaceful and quiet. We have no hesitation in recommending Nanette’s property.

Great place for what we needed. The house was very clean, supply in the house was great too.

We LOVED staying here!
